description: This is a PHP unit test class for the JobCategoryService component in the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods related to retrieving job category data.

classes.name: JobCategoryServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the JobCategoryService methods related to job category retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of JobCategoryService, and populates test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryList
methods.description: Tests the getJobCategoryList() method of JobCategoryService to ensure it returns expected job category data.

methods.name: testGtJobCategoryById
methods.description: Tests the getJobCategoryById() method of JobCategoryService for correct retrieval of a job category by ID.
